name: object-processing
title: Object Processing
author: bespoked
description: Turns on Moonraker's enable_object_processing so adaptive bed mesh gets per-object data. Enabling 'Exclude Object' in your slicer is preferred; this can cause long processing times and high memory use on very large gcode files (> 100MB).
tagline: Enable Moonraker object processing for adaptive mesh.
attributions:
# Attributions - object-processing

**Plugin author:** paxx12 (Extended Firmware overlay `36-feature-print-preferences`), packaged by Bespok3d

Turns on Klipper's exclude-object handling.
